title: Hardware interface constraints
description: The Mashbot web client shall run on hardware capable of connecting to the Internet, running a modern HTTP 1.1 web browser, and including a keyboard, pointing device, and writable volatile storage. The server shall run on hardware capable of connecting to the Internet as a server, interfacing with database software, and running networking software.
acceptance_criteria: Client hardware supports Internet connectivity and HTTP 1.1 browser

verse: The Mashbot web client runs on any computer hardware meeting the following criteria: Capable of connecting to the Internet, Capable of running a modern HTTP 1.1 web browser, Includes a keyboard and a pointing device, Includes writable volatile storage. The Mashbot server runs on any computer hardware meeting the following criteria: Capable of connecting to the Internet as a server. Capable of interfacing with modern database software. Capable of running a modern suite of networking software.

title: Software interface constraints
description: Mashbot shall interface with an internal user database for authentication, expect the web client to support HTTP 1.1 and HTML 4.0, interface with existing database software, provide a publishing and aggregation platform interface for content distribution and social network data collection, and run on an operating system capable of serving encrypted dynamic web pages with Internet connectivity.

verse: Authentication Mashbot authenticates users against it's internal user database. Campaign Manager Web Client Mashbot interfaces with the users web browser and expects that it is capable of HTTP 1.1 and HTML 4.0. Database Mashbot software interfaces with an existing database software.
